profile.summary: etimberg is a Senior JavaScript developer with deep expertise in frontend data visualization, particularly through extensive contributions to Chart.js. Their work demonstrates strong proficiency in mathematical calculations for charting (angles, scaling, padding), debugging complex edge cases (division-by-zero, NaN handling), and architectural refactoring of large-scale JavaScript libraries. Their contributions span core charting mechanics, cross-browser compatibility, and collaborative code improvements, positioning them as an expert in visualization algorithm design and prototype-based JavaScript systems.
